tool_selection.reasoning: SHAP provides a reliable, game-theoretic attribution of feature contributions to the prediction, helping identify which features most push the model toward >50K. Integrated Gradients provide a consistent gradient-based attribution from a zero baseline, useful for detecting impactful perturbations. Sensitivity analysis directly measures how changes to individual features affect the class probability, enabling precise counterfactual identification.
